description:
Input schema for Seedance 2.5 Studio video generation.

Same as Seedance 2.5, but all references are automatically uploaded to the
private virtual portrait library for enhanced character consistency.

Three task categories (auto-detected from parameters):
- First frame / First & last frame: set image (and optionally end_image)
- Multi-reference: set reference_images / reference_videos / reference_audios (audio-only supported)
- Text-to-video: provide prompt only

The API determines the specific task type (Video Editing, Video Extension,
or Video Reference) automatically. For Video Editing tasks, duration must
be -1. For First & Last Frame, Video Editing, Video Extension, and
first-frame image-to-video tasks, ratio must be 'adaptive'.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video content. Supports English, Spanish, Indonesian, Portuguese, Japanese, Malay, Thai, Arabic, Vietnamese, and Korean.
examples: A cat stretches lazily on a sunlit windowsill, yawning as golden afternoon light filters through sheer curtains.
prompt.title: Prompt

image.description: First-frame image for image-to-video generation. Ratio must be 'adaptive'. Mutually exclusive with reference inputs.
image.title: Image

end_image.description: Last-frame image for first+last frame video generation. Requires image to be set as the first frame. Ratio must be 'adaptive'.
end_image.title: End Image

reference_images.description: Reference images for multimodal generation (up to 30). Use prompt to describe how to use each, e.g. 'Image 1', 'Image 2'. Mutually exclusive with image/end_image.
reference_images.title: Reference Images

reference_videos.description: Reference videos for multimodal generation (up to 10). Each 2-30s, total max 30s. Formats: mp4/mov (MOV recommended for best quality). Mutually exclusive with image/end_image.
reference_videos.title: Reference Videos

reference_audios.description: Reference audios for multimodal generation (up to 10). Each 2-30s, total max 30s. Formats: wav/mp3. Audio-only input is supported.
reference_audios.title: Reference Audios

resolution.description: Video resolution. 720p for balanced quality, 480p for fastest.

ratio.description: Aspect ratio. Must be 'adaptive' for image-to-video, first+last frame, video editing, and video extension tasks. 'adaptive' auto-selects based on input content.

duration.description: Duration in seconds (4-30), or -1 for auto-select. Must be -1 for Video Editing tasks.
duration.title: Duration

output_format.description: Output video format. MOV provides higher color precision (YUV 4:4:4); recommended for professional workflows and when using video references.

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate synchronized audio with the video.
generate_audio.title: Generate Audio

watermark.description: Whether to add watermark to the output video.
watermark.title: Watermark

safety_filter.description: Enable input safety filtering. Set to false to disable NSFW content filtering on inputs.
safety_filter.title: Safety Filter

safety_identifier.description: Unique identifier of end user for platform safety policy. Must be fixed and unique per user, max 64 chars. Recommended: hash of username, user ID, or email. Also used to namespace asset groups.
safety_identifier.title: Safety Identifier

title: AppInput
